items.title: AI日报

items.title: ElevenLabs is now on OpenRouter
items.summary: 这篇内容聚焦「Agent Skill、Harness、工具调用和自动化研发」。原文摘要显示：ElevenLabs is now on OpenRouter with 9 Text to Speech and 2 Speech to Text models. Narrate, build a voice agent, and turn meetings into speaker-labelled notes.
items.insightText: 重点看任务拆分、工具编排、验证闭环和可复用工程抽象，判断能否迁移到 Auto-Research / Agent Coding 链路。
